L1_adsBoltConsumer.interpretation: The DLC Bolt effect sets the six flags to Mini Scout's base values. The engine BoltActionData member list (SDK strings) includes ReturnToZoomAfterBoltAction, HoldBoltActionUntilFireRelease, UnZoomOnBoltAction, TriggerBoltActionWhenOutOfAmmo, ForceBoltActionOnFireTrigger and HoldBoltActionUntilZoomRelease. The in-game description is 'Enables rechambering while aiming down sights.' Individual hash-to-name mapping is not established.
L1_adsBoltConsumer.prediction: DLC Bolt rifles should behave like Mini Scout: stay in ADS while rechambering, with no change to the mechanical bolt cycle.

L2_miniScoutInterdictor.result: Mini Scout's base bolt block already has the DLC Bolt flag pattern; Interdictor has the unmodified sniper pattern. Mini Scout is the stay-in-ADS control and Interdictor the leave-ADS control.

L3_zoomFraction.result: Pump shotguns separate the two readings: 590A1 (M87A1) hip fraction Field_2084d4bf 0.6 with zoom fraction 1.0; DP12 0.57/1.0; KSG 0.8/1.0. Site M87A1 94.737 RPM equals the full cycle; a hip-fraction firing gate would give 138.46 RPM. Zoom fraction is 1.0 on every weapon whose flags never leave ADS, consistent with a zoom-return role.
L3_zoomFraction.nextTest: M87A1 hipfire maximum cadence: 94.74 (full cycle) versus 138.46 RPM (fraction gate).

L4_reconMinusOne.result: Class_582cbe36 is a general firing-override class with nine instances. Every instance uses -1 for float fields it does not override (for example WME_Firerate900_M10 sets rate of fire and leaves delay -1). The six Recon blocks set speed and both completion fractions; L115 and Interdictor Recon blocks use M2010's fractions 0.75/0.859155. Recon speed divided by base speed is 1.111 (1/0.9) on four rifles, 1.1165 on L115 and 1.1429 on Interdictor.
